evidence.claim: The service is offered through the ICP Smart Services website and the ICP Smart App, and requires login with UAE Pass. The page also says customers may visit a service centre in the UAE (Customer Happiness Centers operate during working hours; the smart services are available 24/7).
evidence.authority: Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs & Port Security (ICP)

evidence.claim: Documents listed for this category include the passport, a personal photo, a lease agreement and, for relatives, proof of kinship (plus a copy of the personal identification document for Afghanistan / Iran / Iraq).
evidence.authority: Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs & Port Security (ICP)
evidence.section_or_page: List of Required Documents for Service (Visitor – Issuance of residency visa without employment)

evidence.claim: For the Green Residence Investor category the terms include a passport valid for no less than 6 months and approval from the competent authorities and authorization for the applicant to conduct the activity. To maintain and renew the residency the investor must continue to meet all the conditions and must notify the issuing authority if any of them are no longer met.
evidence.authority: Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs & Port Security (ICP)
evidence.section_or_page: Terms and Conditions (category: Green Residence Investor)

evidence.claim: For the category "Government, private, or free zone entities for entry visa issuance for a work mission Or Residency", the listed terms are a valid health insurance policy within the UAE, a passport valid for no less than 6 months and a return travel ticket. Approval from the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MOHRE) is required if the employer is subject to the Labour Relations Regulation Law or the applicant is a domestic worker.
evidence.authority: Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs & Port Security (ICP)
evidence.section_or_page: Terms and Conditions (category: Government, private, or free zone entities for entry visa issuance for a work mission Or Residency)

evidence.claim: Documents listed for family members of a foreign resident: passport; personal photo; water/electricity bill; proof of kinship (attested marriage contract, children's birth certificates); birth certificates to prove children's ages, or documents proving special needs regardless of age; an employment certificate showing family monthly income and housing provision; a copy of the personal identification card (for Afghanistan / Iran / Iraq); and valid health insurance.
evidence.authority: Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs & Port Security (ICP)
evidence.section_or_page: List of Required Documents for Service (Resident – Family members of a foreign resident)

evidence.claim: Financial solvency must be demonstrated, with a minimum monthly income of AED 3,000 plus employer-provided housing, or AED 4,000 if housing is not provided.
evidence.authority: Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs & Port Security (ICP)
evidence.section_or_page: Terms and Conditions (Resident – Family members of a foreign resident)

evidence.claim: The foreign national (sponsor/head of the family) must hold a valid residence permit in the UAE.
evidence.authority: Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs & Port Security (ICP)
evidence.section_or_page: Terms and Conditions (Resident – Family members of a foreign resident)

evidence.claim: Available through the ICP Smart App and the ICP Smart Services website; the service requires login using UAE Pass. The page also refers customers to ICP service centres in the UAE.
evidence.authority: Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs & Port Security (ICP)

evidence.claim: Yes, an appointment is required in advance for certain cases in which the customer needs to visit the centre (biometric/fingerprint procedures). However, simple inquiries and basic follow-ups do not require a prior appointment.
evidence.authority: Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs & Port Security (ICP)
evidence.section_or_page: Is an appointment required to visit the center?

evidence.claim: Download the UAE Pass application and register for an account. Verify your account (only for Emirates ID card holders) using face verification on the mobile app or visit the nearest UAE Pass kiosk with your Emirates ID.
evidence.authority: Telecommunications and Digital Government Regulatory Authority (TDRA)

evidence.claim: General documents for a visa: a coloured personal photo with a white background, a copy of the passport valid for more than 6 months, a return flight ticket in some cases, valid health insurance, and additional documents depending on the type of visa.
evidence.authority: Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs & Port Security (ICP)
evidence.section_or_page: What are the general required documents?

evidence.claim: The service is delivered through the EmaraTax platform, available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. A banner on the FTA site states that FTA services are only available through UAE PASS.

For the Resident category the required documents are a passport and a personal photo, and the photo must comply with ICAO standards. Channels listed are the ICP Smart Services Website, the ICP Smart App and ICP customer happiness centres (including centres named Khalifa, Al Jazira, Al Ain and the Residency and Foreigners Affairs Department – Al Dhafra). The service requires login using UAE Pass.
evidence.authority: Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs & Port Security (ICP)
